sources.title: Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL)
sources.notes: Access historically limited to ~14 patent offices worldwide under non-disclosure TKDL Access Agreements. A 2022 Cabinet decision approved a phased, paid-subscription model for wider access; there is no open bulk-download or public API. Never scrape or fabricate TKDL entries — record URL and this limitation only. The assistant should point users to TKDL rather than claim to search its contents.
